parameter_rules.numpy: axis=None reduces all axes; a literal integer must be in [-rank,rank). Negative integers wrap. Other axis expressions are unsupported.
parameter_rules.pandas_1_5: axis defaults to 0. Negative integers are invalid. index/rows mean 0 and columns means 1 when rank is 2. None follows the axis-0 reducer default.
parameter_rules.quantile: q precedes axis in the positional signature. This subset requires scalar literal q in [0,1]; pandas defaults q to 0.5. NumPy q is required.
parameter_rules.scale_1_3: axis must be integer 0 or 1 and less than rank. with_mean/with_std default True, copy defaults True. Both statistics disabled means row_preserving. Unresolved flags, copy=False, or unsupported arguments yield unknown.
parameter_rules.optional_arguments: Only axis and scalar q are reviewed on reducers. Other explicit options and positional tails, including out, where and overwrite_input, yield unknown. scale additionally supports its three boolean flags.
